svg.text: PLACEHOLDER: replace me with your drawing
ola/modules/amplifier/ - Amplifier with an input attenuator
When it is seen: when the measurement file has input_attenuation_db (an attenuator in front of
What to draw: like image 8, but between P1 and the amplifier input there is the attenuator: P1
→ attenuator → IN of the amplifier. The output of the amplifier goes, as before, to P2.
Details: the attenuator with the symbol of image 7; write "dB" (without a number: the value
depends on the file) or leave it empty. The attenuator must be included in the calibration (a
hint: the calibration plane is after it, or a line that contains it).
Save your drawing with this name (.svg, .png, .jpg or .webp). While this file is here, the program uses its own diagram.
